package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"log"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for background_goroutine_started_inside_transaction_scope: Goroutines launched while relying on open transaction state.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type NotificationService struct{}
func (n *NotificationService) Send(ctx context.Context, userID int, msg string) {}

func placeOrder(db *gorm.DB, userID int, notifier *NotificationService) error {
	tx := db.Begin()
	if tx.Error != nil {
		return tx.Error
	}

	order := OrderRecord{UserID: userID, Status: "pending", Total: 99.95}
	if err := tx.Create(&order).Error; err != nil {
		tx.Rollback()
		return err
	}

	go func() {
		notifier.Send(context.Background(), userID, "order placed")
		if err := tx.Model(&order).Update("status", "notified").Error; err != nil {
			log.Printf("update failed: %v", err)
		}
	}()

	return tx.Commit().Error
}

type OrderRecord struct {
	ID     int `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	UserID int
	Status string
	Total  float64
}
